patch_description: The reference squared ratio is 1/4.1658 ≈ 0.24003. The current program achieves ~0.22 (ratio ~0.47). A key issue is the soft-min/soft-max surrogate at fixed temperatures gets stuck, and the objective is scale-invariant, so the optimizer wastes effort on scale. Improvements: (1) renormalize points (centroid to origin, dmax=1) after each optimization stage so the optimizer focuses purely on shape; (2) use more restarts with a dedicated seeded RNG and slightly larger perturbations for diversity; (3) add a final direct hill-climbing polish that perturbs each point greedily, accepting only moves that increase the true ratio dmin/dmax — this directly targets the actual metric; (4) also try a second initialization from a randomized arrangement (points on a sphere with jittered angles) for a different basin. These are cheap and fit comfortably within the timeout.
